summary: A filtering input that commits to a selection, in three sizes, three shapes and three shadows, single or multiple with removable chips.

props.name: items
props.description: What to choose from. Same shape as Autocomplete's: `label` is matched and shown, `description` and `avatar` are optional.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the input, for what the field expects rather than a restatement of the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and width of the input. The popup and the trigger column follow it.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius, applied to the input and the popup together. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the input. `inset` reads as a well, `outset` as a raised control.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows more than one selection. Choices become removable chips under the input.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear button beside the trigger. Ignored when `multiple`, where each chip removes itself and a clear-all would be a second way to do the same thing at a different scale.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the field.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the results with a loading row, for an async source. The fetching itself is yours; this is only the state.

props.name: animated
props.description: Fades the popup in and out. Turn it off for a static popup, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`, which is right almost always; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.
